exampleEn: Even when others disagreed, she stood her ground on the issue.
exampleKo: 다른 사람들이 반대했지만, 그녀는 그 문제에 대해 자신의 입장을 고수했다.
gameExamples: In a debate, it's important to stand your ground and present your arguments confidently.
When challenges arise, you must stand your ground to protect your beliefs.
